note: Personal markers, not certificates or badges and not a level. Each is derived from what the app stores. 'words' counts vocabulary and lesson word cards reviewed at least once (started, not mastered). 'prayerRead' needs a timed read-aloud of a siddur text, which the learner times and marks themselves (self-reported). 'coverage' is the share of lines Aleph holds, for the best of the three services, whose letters and signs the learner has been taught (not fluent reading). Dates: 'dated' when a stored timestamp shows when; 'noticed' when the app only saw it on the Progress screen.

milestones.label: First prayer text read aloud and timed (self-reported)
Prayer book coverage: 25% of a service's lines
Prayer book coverage: 50% of a service's lines
Prayer book coverage: 75% of a service's lines
